entities.name: Nike of Samothrace (Winged Victory)
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: A Hellenistic marble sculpture (c. 200-190 BCE) depicting Nike, the Greek goddess of victory, alighting on the prow of a ship. Discovered on Samothrace in 1863, its dramatic pose, wind-swept drapery, and monumental scale make it one of the greatest masterpieces of ancient sculpture and a symbol of triumphant achievement, now at the Louvre.
